task_description: Workstream 4 (Mobile and Accessibility) for the whole frankfabric site: make the landing page and all four 3D demos usable at 390x844 with no horizontal scroll and the controls panel never covering the canvas; provide a full keyboard path with visible focus through chat composer/chips/send, pet buttons/naming, wardrobe menu, and the shared QualityToggle (plus keyboard/AT-reachable equivalents for WS3 clickable 3D props); honor prefers-reduced-motion via a shared hook to gate/scale camera nudges, idle/ambient motion, wardrobe autoRotate, and landing-page CSS animations; and give each canvas a meaningful text alternative. Gate is npm run lint (one expected font warning) + a clean static-export npm run build. Preserve WS1/WS2/WS3 wins. Work on branch a11y/mobile-accessibility; do not push.
